description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kandawala, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in Kandawala, Ratmalana. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
